meta.title: Who We Serve | Green Gate Advisory
meta.description: Tailored climate advisory for governments, exporters, companies, project developers, investors, NGOs and international organisations.

hero.title: Who We Serve
hero.lead: Green Gate Advisory supports public institutions, industrial exporters, carbon developers, investors and international organisations as they navigate climate complexity, regulatory exposure and sustainable project delivery.

intro.heading: Tailored Advisory for Distinct Institutional Mandates
intro.p1: Organisations encounter climate imperatives from diverse vantage points. A sovereign government designing compliance carbon pricing requires different analytical frameworks than an exporter calculating embedded emissions for the EU CBAM, or an institutional investor assessing transition risk across an infrastructure portfolio.
intro.p2: We tailor our technical, regulatory, and finance advisory to each client's specific operational context, institutional maturity, and strategic objectives.

stakeholders.notice: Engagement integrity: Our recommendations reflect client realities without claiming guaranteed financial access, project approvals, or regulatory exemptions.

categoriesSubtitle: Deep-dive into the specific climate challenges, advisory support areas, and deliverables tailored to your organisation.

categories.name: Governments and Public Institutions
categories.summary: National ministries, environmental agencies, regional authorities, and public institutions developing domestic climate frameworks.
supportAreas: National climate policy design, review, and sectoral roadmap alignment
Emissions trading systems (ETS) and carbon pricing mechanism design
Article 6 readiness, ITMO institutional architecture, and registry rules
National MRV systems under the Paris Agreement Enhanced Transparency Framework
National Adaptation Plan (NAP) and NDC implementation planning
Climate finance programming and multilateral fund access
Institutional capacity building and ministry personnel training

categories.name: Companies, Manufacturers and Exporters
categories.summary: Industrial operators, manufacturing corporations, supply-chain entities, and export businesses managing compliance and transition mandates.
supportAreas: Climate-related compliance requirements and risk assessments
EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) exposure and readiness
Compliance ETS exposure analysis, allowance allocation, and surrender strategies
Greenhouse gas emissions inventories across Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3
Decarbonisation roadmaps and operational abatement option evaluation
Corporate sustainability planning, ESG strategy, and reporting readiness
Supplier engagement and primary emissions data collection workflows

categories.name: Carbon Project Developers
categories.summary: Project developers, land managers, technology sponsors, and conservation entities structuring high-integrity carbon credits.
supportAreas: Project opportunity screening and preliminary eligibility assessment
Detailed technical, environmental, and financial feasibility studies
Carbon methodology selection, baseline determination, and additionality testing
Project Design Document (PDD) drafting and activity boundary establishment
MRV planning and digital monitoring framework implementation
Preparation for independent validation and registry registration steps
Carbon credit commercialisation considerations, buyer engagement, and offtake strategy

categories.name: Investors and Financial Institutions
categories.summary: Commercial banks, asset managers, private equity funds, development finance institutions, and philanthropic facilities.
supportAreas: Climate-related investment opportunities and green pipeline origination
Project pipeline assessment, technical screening, and carbon yield due diligence
Regulatory and policy risk assessment across diverse jurisdictions
Climate-related transition risk awareness and portfolio emissions accounting
Financing considerations, grant-to-concessional structuring, and blended finance
Verification of ESG and environmental integrity standards for climate assets

categories.name: International Organisations, NGOs and Research Institutions
categories.summary: Multilateral agencies, non-governmental organisations, academic institutions, and international climate development partnerships.
supportAreas: Technical advisory for international climate cooperation initiatives
Programme design and multilateral intervention logic formulation
Climate finance funding proposals for GCF, GEF, Adaptation Fund, and bilateral facilities
Climate policy diagnostics, MRV architecture, and transparency analysis
Ecosystem and social monitoring frameworks, community safeguards, and FPIC
Applied knowledge development, technical briefings, and sector reports
Institutional capacity building and stakeholder training programmes

cta.heading: Tell Us About Your Organisation's Priorities
cta.description: Whether you are assessing CBAM exposure, structuring a carbon project, preparing a funding proposal or designing a climate policy, our team is ready to discuss the appropriate scope of support.
cta.disclaimer: Independent technical, regulatory and finance advisory. Engagement deliverables are structured around verified client priorities and applicable official rules. We do not guarantee funding approvals or carbon credit issuances.
